units.source_text: “中午休息时间，名人也是一边吃饭，一边全神凝视虚空，一句话也不说……

en.t: “During the noon break, even while eating, the Master stared intently into empty space and did not say a word...

units.source_text: 大概是下了相当困难的一手吧。”

en.t: He had probably played a very difficult move.”

units.source_text: 名人夫人说的是七月二十六日在箱根进行的第四次续弈的事。

en.t: The Master's wife was referring to the fourth continuation of the match, held in Hakone on July 26.
